title: Printing patterns
hints: Outer loop over rows: `for i := 1; i <= n; i++ { ... fmt.Println() }`. Inside, print the row piece by piece with `fmt.Print`, which adds no newline and no spaces between string arguments.
To print something `k` times use `for range k { fmt.Print("*") }`. The pyramid's row `i` is two such loops: `n - i` spaces, then `2*i - 1` stars.
For the table, the inner loop is `for j := 1; j <= n; j++ { fmt.Printf("%4d", i*j) }`. `%4d` pads on the left, so no row ends in a space.
